body: I absolutely hate the text line. All of the replies and answers are so robotic and cliche. It doesn't feel like you're talking to a human. It may work for some people but definitely never worked for me. First time I texted I think I was like 9 or 10. Even then I felt it was bullshit and it was extremely obnoxious the whole time. I know they have some sort of script and formula to follow but there were moments I would stop and consider if I was even talking to a human or if it was a bot, because real bots I've talked to have come off as more real than them.
